projects.name: Mouse Colony Manager
projects.status: M16-based prototype · synthetic cage create/reload checked; M17 paused
projects.summary: A Next.js and Prisma app for cage-first colony operations and animal-first research workflows. The gallery shows an isolated synthetic local prototype.
projects.statusDetail: The demo ran from codex/empty-colony at abdbbdb, with the checkout's pre-existing dirty recovery changes present (23 modified and 11 untracked paths); this portfolio run made no source edits. The local runtime applied all 42 checked-in migrations to a fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16 database. Its dashboard, Animals and Cages screens used synthetic records. One empty cage was created and remained after a fresh Cages page load: A101/R1/006, barcode CM-A101-R1-006, Active, 0/6. No animals were moved, and no console errors were recorded. This is not a pristine M16 build or a release claim. M17 remains paused and its recovery worktree was preserved.

projects.name: AoE2 Hotkey Editor
projects.status: Public compiled-only demo · import, edit, reload and export checks passed; game behavior unverified
projects.summary: A browser editor for inspecting and editing Age of Empires II hotkey profiles, with local browser drafts and a synthetic demo.
projects.statusDetail: The public Build C Pages demo contains compiled static artifacts only; the original application source and Git history remain private. In a fresh signed-out browser, the bundled synthetic profile loaded; House was changed from Q to F11, the browser showed one saved change, and a page reload retained it. Export review validated 444 bindings across two HKP files with one change and no conflicts; the ZIP downloaded and re-imported with House on F11 and no pending changes. Mounted Crossbowman search returned the Cavalry Archer and Heavy Cavalry Archer aliases. No personal profile or game was used. Factory defaults, unresolved contexts and native in-game import/export behavior remain unverified.
